critique.reason: HTML-escaping is not JS-escaping, but the referer must pass ensure_embeddable (host equals embeddable_host). Browsers also normalise backslashes in URLs, and ERB escapes quotes. So breaking out of the string is not realistically reachable. The claim that a full URL as targetOrigin is never delivered is wrong, because postMessage uses the URL's origin.

golden: The code sets X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL which completely disables clickjacking protection. The referer validation can be bypassed (referer headers are easily spoofed), and the fallback to empty string for nil referer masks validation failures.

finding.title: Referer check is spoofable and URI(nil host) comparison

critique.reason: If the referer is missing, `URI('').host` is nil, which is not equal to the non-blank `embeddable_host`, so the check raises InvalidAccess. Malformed URIs are rescued and also denied. A browser sets the Referer itself, so a different site framing the page cannot forge it. Only non-browser clients can spoof it, and the check exists to control framing in browsers. The finding's concern about nil-host comparison does not hold.
